title: Labels
subtitle: Choose products, set the size and print your barcode labels.
search: Search by name, SKU or barcode
codeHint: We use the saved barcode or, if empty, the numeric SKU. Enter 1 to 32 digits to print.
a4Hint: A4 sheet with 5 mm margins and 2 mm gaps. Check alignment before using pre-cut adhesive sheets.
rollHint: Each page uses the selected dimensions. Select the same size in your printer driver.
invalidSize: Use a width of 3–20 cm and a height of 2–20 cm.
emptyPreview: Select a product to preview its label.
previewHint: Preview of the first selected product. Physical dimensions depend on print scaling, not screen size.
printHint: Print at 100% scale with headers and footers off. Print a test label and check that it scans before printing the batch.
quantityError: Use whole quantities starting at 1, with a maximum of {max} labels per print job.
narrowError: A product code is too long for this width. Choose a wider label to keep it readable.
printError: Could not open printing. Try again.
